_comment_bootstrapUsers: Optional local users for email/password login in the Field UI. Omit password to reuse authToken.
_comment_pricing: Field owns pricing locally. Do not add external pricing or CRM blocks to new environments unless the repo intent changes.
_comment_googleOAuth: Google Workspace OAuth stores per-user refresh tokens under googleOAuth.users after consent for Gmail sending and read-only Contacts access. Do not commit real secrets.
